```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(liana)
library(Seurat)
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
my_c <- c('#fe864a', '#c9d179', '#95d0fc', '#fbdd7e', '#388004', '#c760ff', '#76cd26', '#ffbacd', '#d6b4fc',  '#cfaf7b','#8b88f8', '#acc2d9', '#EC8FA3FF', '#FCBA65FF', '#FAECCFFF', '#8D7F99FF', '#8C9D57FF', '#163343FF',  '#D8B70AFF', '#02401BFF', '#A2A475FF', '#81A88DFF', '#972D15FF',  '#894585', '#82cbb2', '#d99b82', '#fdee73', '#5170d7', '#ffd8b1',  '#b7e1a1', '#82a67d', '#b7fffa', '#b790d4', '#f5674a', '#C79FEF', '#DAA520', '#A0522D')
```

# Load scRNA-seq data

```{r}

data <- readRDS('Postnatal_noDBL_raw_annotated.rds')

```

```{r}

data
```


# Check data

```{r}
unique(data@meta.data$Cell_type)
```

```{r}
data %>% dplyr::glimpse()
```

```{r}
data <- NormalizeData(data)
data <- ScaleData(data)


```

# Subset data into P2/P3 and P60

```{r}
P2_3 <- subset(data, subset = Age == 'P2/P3')

P60 <- subset(data, subset = Age == 'P60')

```


```{r}

P2_3

```
```{r}

P60

```


# P2/P3 analysis with Liana



```{r}

dim(P2_3@meta.data)

sum(is.na(P2_3@meta.data))

```


```{r}

Idents(P2_3) <- P2_3$Cell_type

```


```{r}

liana_P2_3<- liana_wrap(P2_3, resource = 'MouseConsensus', idents_col = 'Cell_type')

```


```{r}

liana_P2_3 %>% dplyr::glimpse()

```

```{r}

# We can aggregate these results into a tibble with consensus ranks
liana_P2_3 <- liana_P2_3 %>%
  liana_aggregate()

dplyr::glimpse(liana_P2_3)
```

```{r}

liana_P2_3_sorted <- liana_P2_3[order(liana_P2_3$natmi.edge_specificity,decreasing=TRUE),]

```

```{r}
liana_P2_3_sorted <- read_delim('liana_P2_3_sorted.csv' )
```
```{r}
turbo <- turbo(n=555)
```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=20}

ld <- liana_dotplot(liana_P2_3_sorted, source_groups = c("Epithelial cells"),
                target_groups = c("Endothelial cells", "Mesenchymal cells", "Immune cells", "Neuronal and glial cells"),  ntop=40)


ld <- ld + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.1, hjust=0.5)) + scale_colour_continuous(palette = 'turbo')
ld



ggsave(ld, 
       filename = "Revision_lr_pair_epi_p2_3.svg",
       device = "svg",
       height = 20, width = 9, units = "in")
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=20}

ld <- liana_dotplot(liana_P2_3_sorted, source_groups = c("Endothelial cells"),
                target_groups = c("Epithelial cells", "Mesenchymal cells", "Immune cells", "Neuronal and glial cells"), ntop=40)
```

```{r}

library(viridis)

library(RColorBrewer)
```


```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=10, fig.dpi=300, fig.path='heatmap_p2_3.svg', fig.format='svg'}

liana_P2_3_trunc <- filter(liana_P2_3_sorted, aggregate_rank <= 0.01) # note that these pvals are already corrected



write.csv(liana_P2_3_trunc, "liana_P2_3_trunc.csv", row.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)


svg(filename = 'heatmap_p2_3.svg', width = 10, height = 7)
h <- heat_freq(liana_P2_3_trunc)

h
dev.off()

h

```


```{r}
liana_P2_3_trunc <- read_delim('liana_P2_3_trunc.csv')
```

```{r}
library(circlize)
```
```{r}

liana_P2_3_trunc
```
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=5, fig.dpi=300}

circos.clear()

p <- chord_freq(liana_P2_3_trunc,
                source_groups = c("Epithelial cells", "Endothelial cells", "Mesenchymal cells", "Immune cells", "Neuronal and glial cells"),
                target_groups = c("Epithelial cells", "Endothelial cells", "Mesenchymal cells", "Immune cells", "Neuronal and glial cells"), facing = 'bending.outside', cex = 0.4,
                adj = c(0.5, 4))


p  

```

# P60 analysis with Liana




